title: Cloud Native from Zero
description: A free, hands-on book that takes you from the Linux shell to running Kubernetes like a CKA/CKAD-level operator, all on your own laptop.

volumes.title: Orientation and Lab Setup
volumes.summary: What cloud native is, the map of the CNCF landscape, and a working lab on your laptop.

volumes.title: Linux and the Operating System
volumes.summary: Shell, files, processes, memory, systemd, and the namespaces and cgroups that containers are made of.

volumes.title: Networking
volumes.summary: Ethernet, IP, TCP, DNS, HTTP and TLS, then the Linux networking that Kubernetes builds on.

volumes.title: Distributed Systems
volumes.summary: Failure and CAP, Raft and etcd, and the control loops at the heart of Kubernetes.

volumes.title: Containers
volumes.summary: Images and OCI, runtimes and the CRI, and multi-container apps.

volumes.title: Kubernetes Core
volumes.summary: Architecture, workloads, services, storage, scheduling and cluster operations.

volumes.title: Kubernetes Networking and Security
volumes.summary: CNI and Cilium, Gateway API and service mesh, and cluster security.

volumes.title: Platform and Capstone
volumes.summary: Helm, Kustomize and GitOps, observability, operators, and a capstone that ties it together.

volumes.title: Kubernetes Field Guide
volumes.summary: One card per built-in Kubernetes 1.37 resource, component and mechanism: what it does, a tested example, the key fields, and three ways it fails.
